title: Book in two minutes
detail: Online or by phone. Tell us if anything hurts, or if you're nervous — both change how we plan the visit.

title: Meet us, then the chair
detail: We start with a conversation, not a drill. Then an exam, a gentle clean and X-rays only if you need them.

title: Leave with a written plan
detail: Every option, what it costs and what your insurance covers — on paper, before you decide anything.
